negative_controls.description: evaluate_metric_gain(ignore_decay=True) celebrates the Goodhart campaign; the live evaluator raises P1 and does not.
A first-token-parse metric that tracks the end-state as skill rises must not raise P1.

report.answer: Across a 6-iteration synthetic improvement loop (32 cases per iteration), the gameable proxy's Pearson r with an independent exact end-state oracle moved from 0.99995 to -0.101305 while the proxy mean rose 0.329117 and the outcome mean moved -0.221657. The platform raised P1 and refused to celebrate. A faithful first-token-parse metric on the same loop kept high correlation and was celebrable. Demoting the decayed metric appended a status event; historical run bytes and the hash chain were unchanged; rewrite_run raised LedgerImmutableError. SUCCESS:TST-0308

correlation_series.note: A single correlation is a snapshot and cannot show decay. These lists are per-iteration Pearson r and Spearman rho.

report.evidence_requirement: Report the metric-to-outcome correlation per iteration as a series. A single correlation is a snapshot and cannot show decay, which is the entire phenomenon.

implementation.outcome_judgement: deterministic exact end-state check (text.strip() == str(expected)), which is not the metric

report.question: Question: every benchmark metric is a proxy. Pair each primary metric with an independent outcome judgement on the same runs (human-labelled or a deterministic end-state check that is NOT the metric), and monitor the correlation between them over improvement iterations. A metric whose correlation with the real outcome decays as the system optimises it has become a target rather than a measure, and the platform must raise that as a P1 rather than celebrate the metric gain.
tests_required: Correlation series across at least 5 improvement iterations.
Synthetic Goodhart control: optimise a deliberately gameable metric and confirm the decay is detected.
Metric retirement path: a decayed metric must be demotable without rewriting history in the results ledger.
report.title: Goodhart probe: catch a metric that improves while the outcome it proxies gets worse
